# GUIDELINES.md

Recommendations for choosing among valid patterns in this repository. Binding constraints live in [RULES.md](RULES.md). Verification commands are summarized in [TESTING.md](TESTING.md) and [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md).

## E2E capability gating: `TEST_MODE`, `BROWSER_API`, and `EXTERNAL_API`

The shared Playwright suite under `realworld/specs/e2e` must run against implementations with different architectures (SPA-only, browser talking to a live API, API setup without full UI). Mode and flags are defined in [realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts). Specs import `BROWSER_API` and `EXTERNAL_API` and skip or branch when a capability is not available.

| Pattern | When to use | Example in repo |
|--------|-------------|-----------------|
| **Default / UI-only** | Flows that need only forms, navigation, and DOM assertions; no live backend and no `page.route` client tests. | `realworld/specs/e2e/auth.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/health.spec.ts` (navbar and load checks). |
| **`BROWSER_API` true** | The implementation is a SPA whose HTTP client must be validated with mocked responses (`page.route`) while still exercising real UI code—validation errors, auth errors, DELETE treated as success on any 2xx, malformed JSON. | [realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts); DELETE status tests in `realworld/specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts` and `realworld/specs/e2e/comments.spec.ts` (see skills/add-spa-route-mock-test/SKILL.md). |
| **`EXTERNAL_API` true** | Setup and assertions need a reachable RealWorld-compatible API (`API_BASE`, default `https://api.realworld.show/api` unless overridden). Use API helpers for register, articles, follow, and demo users. | `realworld/specs/e2e/navigation.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/social.spec.ts`, tag health checks in `realworld/specs/e2e/health.spec.ts`. |

**Recommendation:** When adding E2E coverage, gate with `test.skip(!BROWSER_API, ...)` or `test.skip(!EXTERNAL_API, ...)` instead of duplicating spec files. Match existing imports from `./helpers/config` in [realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts). For new domain flows, follow skills/add-e2e-domain-spec/SKILL.md and selectors in `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md` (contract detail in [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md)). For API error UI cases, prefer skills/add-e2e-api-error-test/SKILL.md. For feeds, tags, pagination, and social flows that branch on `EXTERNAL_API`, see skills/add-e2e-navigation-social-spec/SKILL.md.

**Gap:** Full `TEST_MODE` derivation and all env vars in `config.ts` are not excerpted in harness evidence; treat [realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts](realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts) as the source of truth when wiring a new implementation.

## Shared Playwright E2E vs local Vitest unit tests

Conformance browser tests live in the vendored tree `realworld/specs/e2e`. Angular unit tests live next to application code under `src/app` as `*.spec.ts` and run with Vitest from the repository root.

| Pattern | When to use | Command / workflow |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Vitest (local)** | Isolate services, interceptors, and components; fast feedback on HTTP client logic, auth, and feature services without starting the dev server or hitting a backend. | Documented in [TESTING.md](TESTING.md): `bun run test`. Skill: skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md. Typical paths: `src/app/core/**`, `src/app/features/**/services/*.spec.ts`. |
| **Playwright (shared suite)** | Prove the SPA meets RealWorld UI and routing contracts (`SELECTORS.md`), including flows that need `BROWSER_API` or `EXTERNAL_API`. | `bun run test:e2e` (non-`@security`) or `bun run test:e2e:security`. Skills: skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md, skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md. Single-file iteration: skills/run-playwright-single-spec/SKILL.md. |

**Recommendation:** After changing logic in `src/app`, run Vitest first, then run Playwright when routes, selectors, or error rendering change. Do not add duplicate conformance scenarios under `src/app` when the shared spec in `realworld/specs/e2e` already covers the behavior—extend the shared spec with the gating patterns above. The runnable SPA is described in [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md); root [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) links the component map.

**Gap:** CI in supplied evidence runs Playwright and build; Vitest is documented locally but may not gate every pipeline (see [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

## Angular feature layout under `src/app`

The Conduit SPA organizes routes and feature code by domain area. Local conventions for agents are in [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md).

| Pattern | When to use | Where it lives |
|--------|-------------|----------------|
| **Feature modules / folders** | User-facing flows: article list and editor, profile and favorites, account settings. | `src/app/features/` (e.g. article, profile, settings per [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md)). |
| **Core** | Auth, JWT storage, HTTP interceptors, and app-wide services shared across features. | `src/app/core/` (auth and interceptors referenced in [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md)). |
| **Routing** | URL shapes required by shared E2E specs (`/`, `/login`, `/register`, `/editor`, `/article/:slug`, `/profile/:username`, etc.). | `src/app/app.routes.ts` (detail in [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md) and `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`). |

**Recommendation:** Add new Conduit screens inside the matching `src/app/features/*` folder with co-located `*.spec.ts` for Vitest. Keep selector classes and routes aligned with the frontend contract so Playwright specs pass without forked copies. For architecture and data flow across `src/app` and `realworld`, see [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Playwright: full E2E vs `@security` only

Two root scripts split the same `realworld/specs/e2e` tree by grep tag (`package.json`).

| Pattern | When to use | Command / workflow |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Non-security suite** | Day-to-day conformance: auth, articles, comments, navigation, settings, error handling, null fields. | `bun run test:e2e` (`playwright test --grep-invert @security`). Skill: skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md. |
| **Security-tagged specs only** | XSS and other tests marked `@security` (e.g. `realworld/specs/e2e/xss-security.spec.ts` in inventory). | `bun run test:e2e:security`. Skill: skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md. |

**Recommendation:** Do not run the full suite when you only change security-sensitive rendering; use `test:e2e:security`. After broad SPA or routing changes, run `test:e2e` first. Root Playwright config merges `baseConfig` from `realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts` (inferred from analysis).

## API contract verification: Bruno vs Hurl

Both runners target the same OpenAPI contract under `realworld/specs/api`. Hurl files are the maintained source; Bruno collections under `realworld/specs/api/bruno` are generated and checked in CI in the realworld tree (inferred from analysis).

| Pattern | When to use | Entry point |
|--------|-------------|-------------|
| **Bruno** | Manual exploration, folder-by-folder runs, teams already using Bruno CLI; default host `http://localhost:8000` via `HOST`. | `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-bruno.sh`. Skill: skills/run-bruno-api-tests/SKILL.md. Details: [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md). |
| **Hurl** | Scripted CI, sequential runs with shared `uid` for auth isolation; explicit `host` and `uid` variables. | `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh`. Skill: skills/run-hurl-api-tests/SKILL.md. Sync before commit: skills/check-bruno-hurl-sync/SKILL.md. |

**Recommendation:** Prefer Hurl when adding or changing API scenarios so `hurl-to-bruno.js` can regenerate Bruno and `bruno-check` can fail on drift. Prefer Bruno for interactive debugging against a local backend. Neither runner replaces Playwright; use [TESTING.md](TESTING.md) for layered verification (Vitest → E2E → API).

**Gap:** Root CI may not invoke these shell scripts directly; confirm backend host and env in `realworld/specs/api/README.md` before changing defaults (file not excerpted).

## Format on commit: Prettier and lint-staged

| Pattern | When to use | Evidence |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| **Pre-commit via Husky + lint-staged** | Keep staged TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JSON, and Markdown consistent without relying on CI alone. | Active hook `husky-pre-commit` runs `npx lint-staged` ([HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md), `.husky/pre-commit`). |
| **Manual / CI format check** | Verify the whole tree before push or when not committing (e.g. agent edits). | `bun run format:check` from `package.json`; proposed hooks in [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md) reference the same command. |

**Recommendation:** Rely on the active pre-commit hook for day-to-day edits. After large refactors or harness-only changes, run `bun run format:check` locally. Exact `lint-staged` glob rules are not in supplied evidence (coverage gap); if pre-commit fails unexpectedly, inspect lint-staged config in the repo root when present.

**Contrast with binding rules:** Prettier does not replace tests. [RULES.md](RULES.md) and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) still expect Vitest and Playwright verification for application changes.
